metronidazole.t: Diuretics, NSAID, renin-angiotensin system antagonists, or metronidazole may increase lithium serum concentrations.
Concurrent use of metronidazole with lithium may provoke lithium toxicity due to reduced renal clearance.

carbamazepine.t: Monitor patients closely for adverse reactions of methyldopa, phenytoin, and carbamazepine.
Concomitant administration of methyldopa, phenytoin, or carbamazepine with lithium may increase the risk of adverse reactions with these drugs.

nsaid.t: Diuretics, NSAID, renin-angiotensin system antagonists, or metronidazole may increase lithium serum concentrations.
NSAID decrease renal blood flow, resulting in decreased renal clearance and increased serum lithium concentrations.
